title.rendered: First Touch Soccer 2021 (FTS 21) Mod Apk Obb Data Download

content.rendered:
Download First Touch Soccer 2021 (FTS 21) Mod Apk Obb Data for Android, works completely offline with latest player transfers, graphics improvement in terms of real player faces and pitch modification.

First Touch Soccer 2021 game for Android let you start your football management career, by winning various league matches which takes your team to the top.

In FTS 2021 Mod Apk, players faces have been improved, similar to that of Dream League Soccer, the faces matches to the one you see in real life football matches scenes.

Stadiums in First Touch Soccer 2021 Android version, are more wider which gives better view when playing with your opponent and with that, you can easily spot the positions of your team mates and pass the ball to any of them.

Games modes such as Tournament, Quick Match, Start Player Match, Training are all working in the 2021 version of First Touch Soccer for all Android phones.

Daily Challenge matches are still present in FTS 2021, where you can play with random opponents everyday and earn more coins or money to spend within the the game.

Unlimited or more amount of money is available in First Touch Mobile soccer game of year 2021, this coins helps you to buy good performing players from other teams.

However if you don’t want the unlimited amount of money in FTS 2021 game you can delete the profile.dat file by going to Android folder, click data folder, then search for profile.dat and delete the file.

At this time you might be asking of player transfers, yes, all the players have been transferred or are in the teams they supposed to be, example of transfers done recently are, move of ighalo to Manchester United, Minamino to Liverpool etc.

Commentary feature of FTS 21 is still working well, with some minor improvements, you can still hear the name of some players been called during live matches etc.

The multiplayer feature of FTS is still in development, it will be similar to that of Dream League football game for Android when fully released.

How To Install FTS 2021 Apk Obb Data

In this section is where you get to know how to set up FTS 2021 on your Android device, the steps is easy to understand if you carefully read it and follow instructions.

Use Zarchiver app for Smooth Extraction of files >>> Download Zarchiver Apk Pro App

Installation And Game Play Video

https://youtu.be/bbV5NLi1Bag

Steps to install FTS 21 are:

  1. Install and open Zarchiver App.
  2. Use it to open downloads folder.
  3. Locate Obb FTS 2021 Zip file in your downloads folder.
  4. Click on the Obb Zip file for FTS 2021.
  5. Options menu will pop up, click “Extract”.
  6. Navigate or go to phone or Device memory.
  7. Click Android folder.
  8. Click Obb folder which is in Android folder.
  9. Now Click “Extract Icon” which looks like a arrow pointing downwards.
  10. To extract Data FTS 2021 Zip file, similarly, follow the steps above and go to Android folder, click Data Folder and Extract the FTS data file.

Note that FTS Data Zip file is very important to extract, so that you can get latest players transfers and full team kits for the season.
